name: Wild for Taranaki Community Fund
summary: Annual community fund for biodiversity restoration, trapping and monitoring projects in Taranaki, New Zealand, open to members and non-members, with up to NZD 10,000 a project.
reporting: Funds must be used within 12 months, and recipients give a brief report on outcomes with photos.

eligibility.rule: Action Hub profile set up or reviewed within the last 12 months

calls.label: Annual round (March)
calls.recurring: Applications are accepted annually during March.

status.quote: The 2026 Community Fund is now closed.

recurring.quote: Applications will be accepted annually during March.

geography.quote: The Community Fund is intended to support biodiversity restoration and conservation projects across Taranaki.

access.quote: To apply - download the application form and email the completed form to [email protected].

window.quote: Applications will be accepted annually during March.

amount.quote: A maximum of $10,000 (GST exc) can be applied for.

reporting.quote: Applicants must provide a brief report on the outcomes of funding (including photos), so that we can monitor how our funding makes an impact on Taranaki's biodiversity.

applicant_types.quote: Application process for non-member organisations and private land-owners

effort.quote: 1. Sign on and register your project (if you haven't already) on the Wild for Taranaki ACTION HUB
2. Fill in the form below and tell us what you are seeking funding for. 3. Send your completed form to contact@wildfortaranaki.nz by the 31st March.

eligibility.quote: Applicants must have set up or reviewed their Action Hub profile in the last 12 months.

after_award.quote: Applicants must provide a brief report on the outcomes of funding (including photos), so that we can monitor how our funding makes an impact on Taranaki's biodiversity.
